title.zh: 将南三宝颜省利亚尔高市镇索米诺特村的名称变更为圣安东尼奥村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Sominot in the Municipality of Liargao, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, to San Antonio
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Sominot in the Municipality of Liargao, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, to San Antonio
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Sominot tại Thị trấn Liargao, Tỉnh Zamboanga del Sur thành San Antonio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Sominot ในเทศบาล Liargao, จังหวัด Zamboanga del Sur เป็น San Antonio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Sominot di Kotamadya Liargao, Provinsi Zamboanga del Sur menjadi San Antonio
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Sominot di Perbandaran Liargao, Wilayah Zamboanga del Sur menjadi San Antonio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2880_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Sominot in the Municipality of Liargao, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, is changed to San Antonio.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
